findings.title: Member add/remove endpoints read `group_id`, but the new routes only provide `:id`
findings.description: `add_members` and `remove_member` call `params.require(:group_id)`. The route change in `config/routes.rb` adds `delete "members" => "groups#remove_member"` and `put "members" => "groups#add_members"` inside the `resources :groups` block, next to `collection do ... end`. A bare verb inside that block, like the removed `get "users"`, is a member route. Member routes supply `:id`, not `:group_id`. The JS in `discourse/models/group.js` calls `/admin/groups/:id/members.json`, so `params.require(:group_id)` would raise `ParameterMissing` on every add or remove. The specs pass `group_id:` directly, so they do not exercise the real route. I did not open `routes.rb` to confirm the surrounding block, so this rests on the diff alone.

findings.title: `totalPages` is off by one when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit`
findings.description: `totalPages` computes `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`. With 100 members and limit 50 this gives 3 pages, but there are only 2. Clicking "next" from page 2 sets the offset to `min(50 + 50, 100) = 100`, and the request returns an empty page. The formula should be `Math.ceil(user_count / limit)`. The same problem affects `showingLast`, which compares against this value.

findings.title: `{{#unless automatic}}` in the member item template reads the member, not the group
findings.description: The `group-member` item view renders each `User` as its context. `automatic` is a property of the group, so inside this template it resolves against the member and is normally undefined. For automatic groups the remove link therefore still renders, even though `remove_member` rejects those requests. The flag needs to be passed into the item view, or the link needs to be hidden at the list level in `group.hbs`.
